en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  The narrator says that Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) told him, “O Mualla! Even if one prays between rukn and maqaam for a  hundred  years  continuously,  fasting  during  the  day  and passing nights in Qiyam and prostrating so much so that his brows hang in front of his eyes, his back stoops but he is unaware of our rights, there is no reward for him.”
